.. change::
    :tags: usecase, postgresql
    :tickets: 13664

    Added support for reflection of PostgreSQL 18 temporal foreign keys,
    which include the ``PERIOD`` keyword before the last column of the
    constrained and referenced column lists.  Previously, the presence of such
    a constraint would raise an ``AttributeError`` when reflecting the table.
    The constraint is now reflected as a plain foreign key on the same
    columns; reflection of the ``PERIOD`` designation itself is not
    supported, but may be added in a future release.
